edge_labels: Trojanizes SolarWinds Orion business software updates to distribute SUNBURST
Signs and publishes digitally signed installer patch (March-May 2020)
Packages trojanized component SolarWinds.Orion.Core.BusinessLayer.dll
Downloaded and installed by administrators from updates website
Triggers execution of Orion software host framework
Loads digitally signed DLL into host process
Calls OrionImprovementBusinessLayer.Initialize via InventoryManager
Checks process name hash, assembly age threshold (12-14 days), and named pipe guard
Verifies ReportWatcherRetry and domain membership, then scans and disables security processes/services/drivers
Bit-packs stopped services and stores reconnaissance results in ReportWatcherPostpone config key
If all blocklist tests pass, attempts resolution of api.solarwinds.com to test connectivity
If all blocklist and connectivity checks pass, initiates DGA domain generation in while loop
Terminates malware and updates ReportWatcherRetry if DNS A-record matches hardcoded IP blocklists
Retrieves CNAME response pointing to Command and Control domain
Spawns new thread executing HttpHelper.Initialize mimicking Orion Improvement Program
Extracts steganographic commands from GUID/HEX strings to execute Jobs
In at least one instance, deployed previously unseen memory-only dropper TEARDROP
Verifies HKU CTF registry, decodes payload from gracious_truth.jpg, believed to execute customized Cobalt Strike BEACON
Configures hostnames to match victim environments and uses victim-country VPS IPs
Prefers legitimate remote access credentials and pivots using distinct secondary credentials
Remotely executes utilities via temporary file replacement and scheduled task modification
Routinely removes backdoors and tools once legitimate remote access is achieved
Enables lateral movement across victim networks and data theft
